title: Kirklands Creek Campground

services.name: Cabin Rentals
services.desc: If you want a mountain campground experience but don’t really want to “rough it,” you’ll love the cabins at Kirkland Creek Campground. It’s the best way to have a complete outdoors experience - the creek, the pool, trout fishing, the campfires, the facilities and all the activities - plus all the comforts of home. Two of our cabins (pictured) have full kitchen, bedroom with full-size bed, loft with two single beds (great for kids!), bath, and comfortable living area with queen-size sofa bed.
